description: Calculate Iranian court filing fees (هزینهٔ دادرسی) for a monetary claim at a given stage (بدوی / تجدیدنظر / فرجام), using the current official percentages. Use this instead of estimating — the rates are statutory and stage-dependent.

case_type.description: financial = مالی (needs claim_amount_toman), non_financial = غیرمالی (fixed official figure).

claim_amount_toman.description: Claim value in TOMAN (financial claims only).

stage.description: Stage: first = بدوی, appeal = تجدیدنظر, supreme = فرجام/دیوان عالی.

name: calculate_litigation_fee
title: محاسبهٔ هزینهٔ دادرسی — Calculate court filing fees
